tests: ? p in the DEBUG CONSOLE fails with a codegen error, and the console reports a linker error
steps:
1. Open udt-watch-codegen-error.twinproj in the twinBASIC IDE, put a breakpoint on the line marked BREAK (F9) and press F5. The run stops there; VARIABLES shows p as {user defined type, 8 bytes}, with X and Y.
2. Type ? p in the DEBUG CONSOLE and press Enter.
3. Expected: an error that says p has no single value to print. Actual: (compile error: codegen error; check for compilation errors), and the DEBUG CONSOLE prints [LINKER] compilation (codegen) error detected in 'Startup.{temp_procedure}' at line #1.
Control: a watch on p shows {user defined type, 8 bytes}, of type Point, as VARIABLES does, and a watch on p.X shows 7, of type Long (BETA 1005; up to BETA 997 the watch on p failed as ? p does).
Asserted on BETA 1005 by `ide-test.bat --only watches` (the project is test/ide/probes/watches).
